newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Wolford down on 6-mth sales results.
newsitem.headline: Wolford down on 6-mth sales results.

text.p: Shares in luxury hosiery maker Wolford fell 2.79 percent on Friday in Vienna on the back of lower-than-expected first half sales, traders said.
At 1005 GMT Wolford shares traded 38 schillings lower at 1,322 in an overall firm Vienna market. The firm was the top decliner on the Vienna bourse.
Wolford posted a rise in group sales of seven percent to 832 million schillings for the first six months to end October after the market closed on Thursday.
"The figures were lower than expectations. We were expecting a 10 percent rise and it was only seven percent," said one.
Shares were boosted by a large buy order to 1,380 at the start of trade but they fell back shortly afterwards on profittaking, traders said. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
